Topics · Hard times

How do I forgive someone who hurt me? And must I?

The Quran first acknowledges the right of the one hurt, then opens a door of pardon, without compulsion.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:41

The verse says that whoever defends themselves after being wronged is open to no blame. So a response to harm is understood in the text, and one who stood up for themselves is not faulted. Before any talk of pardon, the book acknowledges the right of the one who was hurt. Do not begin by blaming yourself for not having forgiven yet. Anger and pain are not mistakes.

A question for you

Where are you in this?

If you sayI am still angry.
ThenAnger is allowed here, and the verse does not fault the one who was wronged. No one here asks you to move past it quickly.
If you sayI want to forgive, but I do not know how.
ThenThe next two steps say what the Quran offers about this road.
If you sayI do not think they deserve forgiveness.
ThenPardon may not be for them. The next step says whom it is for.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:40

Pittacus wronged by one whom he had it in his power to punish, let him go free, saying, Forgiveness is better than revenge. The one shows native gentleness, the other savagery.

Stoic writings · Golden Sayings 96

Epictetus, Golden Sayings (Crossley)

The verse says the recompense for harm is harm like it, then: whoever pardons and mends, their reward is with God. Justice first, then a door of pardon open to whoever chooses it. And the reward is with God, not with the one who hurt you. So pardon does not depend on their apology or understanding. It is between you and God, and it holds something for you: setting down what you carried.

A question for you

Which is closest to what pardon means to you?

If you sayTo set down the load.
ThenThat is what the verse opens: a pardon that lightens the one who gives it.
If you sayTo go back to how we were.
ThenThe verse does not say that. Pardon is not necessarily a return.
If you sayTo say that what happened does not matter.
ThenThat is not pardon. Pardon is knowing it mattered, and setting the load down.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

Quran · An-Nur 24:22

Translation

Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

Original · Ancient Greek

καὶ ἄφες ἡμῖν τὰ ὀφειλήματα ἡμῶν, ὡς καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν τοῖς ὀφειλέταις ἡμῶν·

the Gospel (Matthew) · 6:12

World English Bible

﴿وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

Quran · Al-Hijr 15:85

Translation

The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

Original · Hebrew

שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל־פָּֽשַׁע׃

Proverbs · 19:11

World English Bible

The verse addresses people of means and standing to pardon and overlook, then asks: do you not love that God should forgive you? Another verse speaks of a graceful overlooking. The question is no threat. It is a quiet mirror: as you hope to be pardoned where you fell short, that may open room inside you for pardon. And what is lovely in it is that it carries no endless reproach.

A question for you

What do you take from this page?

If you sayTo leave the page open for now.
ThenThat is allowed, and there is no deadline.
If you sayTo begin by overlooking something small.
ThenThat is one way to begin. The verse starts with those near you.
If you sayTo ask for pardon for myself too.
ThenThe verse itself reminds us we all need it. There is a page on that.
